title: Momentum Strategies Across Asset Classes: Risk Factor Approach to Trend Following
summary: In-sample conditional calendar claims overlap prior families; exact execution settings remain unresolved. No new return definition.
about: Cross-asset momentum and conditional equity calendar patterns.
findings: Table41 reports ES first/third-Friday-week four-week momentum Sharpe0.69,t2.8 during2000–14, selected in sample. Footnote88's different three-day expiry rule is not that tested weekly strategy.
mechanism: Option-hedge unwinds and scheduled investment flows are proposed; actual flow direction or independent net profitability was not verified.
build_on: Not admitted: overlap with prior expiry/month-turn families plus unresolved exact entry/settlement clock, holiday handling and front-contract construction. Do not reuse combined-index statistics for a component.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Calendar/lagged-price calculations are feasible. Faithful tradable code still needs material source settings; a daily-flat port would change the multi-day strategy.
reading_scope: Selected seasonality discussion pp84–93, footnote88 and Table41 of188-page primary guide; not full guide.
source_version: Marko Kolanovic and Zhen Wei; J.P. Morgan15April2015.
owned_input_mapping: Owned ES minute prices supply raw price fields; exact source front-contract rolls, expiry mapping and fill clock remain unverified.
deeper_investigation: No full-guide review or trial now. New authenticated rule/clock evidence and substantive novelty would be required; no window or threshold rescue.
performance_identity_caution: Footnote88: compare ES1 to previous-expiry level three business days before expiry, then hold three days. Table41: separate first/third-Friday-week long-only rule conditioned on prior four weeks. Their performance is not interchangeable.
